### Error Paths

- **team not found** → orgAssignment → 404
- **not org owner** → reqOrgOwnership → 404

## ⚠️ Performance Issues

| Severity | Type | Description | Recommendation |
|----------|------|-------------|----------------|
| high | n_plus_1_queries | RemoveAllRepositoriesFromTeam iterates all team repos, calling RecalculateTeamAccesses per repo, then iterates all members per repo for watch cleanup | Batch access deletion and watch cleanup |
| medium | n_plus_1_queries | RemoveTeamIDFromProtectedBranch is called per branch protection in a loop | Batch update protected_branch records |
| medium | n_plus_1_queries | removeInvalidOrgUser called per team member after deletion | Batch check remaining memberships with single query |

### Optimization Recommendations

- **[P1] query_optimization**: Batch all cleanup operations in DeleteTeam — *Impact: Could reduce from O(R*M + P + M) to O(R + M + P) queries*
